Statement maps (stmt/tuple) have four owner actions: commit, adoption, erasure without the head lock (F-1114) and Final; ledger_stats shared by Bump and RecordVerify (F-1102); restore_snapshot overlays ^IVG.Ledger (F-1801).
The eraser writes the statement maps beside commits without the head lock (F-1114, F-1201); content tables have 25 census writers outside the ledger (writer-census).
Marker and counters are shared by concurrent runs of different targets (F-1303); restore overwrites tombstones and redaction state (F-1801).
Post-commit properties write rdf_props outside the ledger beside commits and erasures (F-1101, F-1306); ledger_stats shared (F-1102).
F-1104 (Enable reads the state before the head lock), F-1114 (the eraser writes ledger maps without it); as-built plans confirmed live.
F-1201/F-1114: the eraser takes no head lock (observed: EraseNodes/EraseGraph finish while it is held); reviewed design HD-1201 holds it.
F-1302/F-1303: the redaction start reads and decides without the head lock (observed: first wait is Batch's lock, LedgerRedact.cls:282).
F-1402: readers check the marker once, without a lock (observed: verify finishes while the head lock is held).
head, stmtNext, statement ids and ledger_revisions seqs hold on every trace; a replacing restore (module 18) breaks head/IdKey agreement and stmtNext (F-1801).
Trace-checked: no statement id reused, head/stmtNext +1 in journal order, ledger_revisions 1..head; by construction every key writer runs under the head lock; F-1801 (restore) is module 11/18's.

Exactly one revision per idempotency key across 9 lost-acknowledgement worlds; replays allocate nothing.

Final rows FK-closed in every trace; create_rel registers endpoints first (LedgerApply.cls:485-488), delete_node removes or refuses incident edges first (:401-413); IRIS enforces the composite FKs at statement time.
Children deleted before nodes (Eraser.cls:130-225, 497-590); every erasure committed; a racing commit makes the erasure fail whole (-124), never leave dangling rows.
